relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: Downregulation of METTL3 had no effect on the overall methylation level of the spinal cord, but it could regulate the methylation level of the OPRM1 gene RNA encoding MOR, partially restore the expression of MOR, and relieve pain in rats.

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 may inhibit the expression of MOR by regulating the methylation level of OPRM1 gene RNA encoding MOR, and ultimately promote the occurrence and development of NPP

key_findings: METTL3 knockdown partially restored spinal MOR expression and relieved pain in CCI rats, via m6A methylation of OPRM1 RNA.
